 Introduction 
 Patrick 
My guests today are Renata Quintini and Roseanne Wincek, co-founders and managing directors of Renegade Partners. Before launching Renegade, Renata and Roseanne were partners at high profile VC firms Lux Capital, and IVP. During our conversation, we explore their careers and what led them to launch Renegade. We cover what it means to invest at the super critical stage in venture and dive into a variety of topics around this theme. We then discuss their investing philosophies more broadly covering what best in class talent pipelines look like, what quality revenue means to them and what worries the most in search of businesses with outsized potential returns. I think this episode highlights that even as competition in venture has intensified, the best VC partners can offer more than just capital. I hope you enjoy my conversation with Renata and Roseanne.
